question: With which of the following states does Tripura share a common border?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tripura **is a **North East State** in India that shares a border with** Bangladesh, Mizoram **and** Assam.**
 
• It is among the **smallest state of India**.
 
• Its **capital** is **Agartala** situated near the border of **Bangladesh** in the** north-western part** of the state.
 
• It is **Spreads over an area of 4,049 square miles** (10,486 square Km) with a population of 36,73,917 (2011).
 
• The **literacy rate of Tripura is 87.8%** (as recorded in the 2011 census).
